instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for any complex interactive components (tables, dialogs), but rely on raw HTML/Tailwind for the landing page grid and cards to ensure full design control.
The 8 cards must be displayed prominently on the landing page in a 4-column grid on large screens. Use the 'Control Room Grid' strategy.
Implement hover effects exactly as specified in components.card to provide that fast, operational feel.
Do not add generic gradients or bright colors. Stick to the charcoal/black/white palette with gray accents.
The header should just contain the 'ACE Driver Hub' branding (bold, clean typography) and a user profile/logout section.
Widescreen optimization is key. Ensure the main container scales well up to 1600px.
accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Maintain high contrast ratios (use gray-900 for primary text on white).
Include hover and focus states for all clickable elements.
